resolution.note: ship removes the merged worktree and branch unless another process works inside it (its own cwd never counts); lane start prunes merged lanes at once by /proc cwds, grace only without /proc, and stops re-reporting gone lanes; proved by test/hook/stop-merged-lane.test.ts and test/ci/ship.test.ts

title: Merged lane worktrees stay on disk and count against the lane budget
body:
On 2026-11-17 all ten lane worktrees whose `krn pr ship` merged (#1318–#1327 and the task-records lane) were still in .krn/worktrees after the merge; `krn lane status` showed each as `merged`, and the lead had to `krn lane drop` them one by one. While they stay they count toward KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE (a lane start refused with grade-no-app-gh still counted). Likely cause: lanes run `krn pr ship` with the worktree as cwd, so the post-merge removal cannot remove the directory it runs in.
Outcome: after a merged ship the worktree and branch are gone whether ship ran from the repository root or from inside the worktree; `krn lane start` also drops every `merged` worktree before counting the budget.
Proof: a test running the ship post-merge cleanup with cwd inside the worktree asserts the directory and branch are removed; a lane-start test with one merged worktree at the budget limit starts.
Files: src/cli/lane.ts, src/cli/pr-ship.ts
